name: audio-transcriber-for-raycast
title: Audio Transcriber for Raycast
description: Transcribe local audio/video files with speaker diarization
author: brianfrank

commands.name: transcribe
commands.title: Transcribe
commands.description: Transcribe a local audio or video file with speaker diarization

commands.name: transcriptions
commands.title: Review Transcriptions
commands.description: Browse, re-export, and manage past transcripts saved to your library folder

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Transcription Status
commands.description: Menu bar indicator showing running background jobs and recent transcripts. Polls once per minute.

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: AssemblyAI API Key
preferences.description: Get one at assemblyai.com/dashboard. Not required if using Local Parakeet backend only.

preferences.name: defaultFormat
preferences.title: Default output format
preferences.description: Initial selection in the format dropdown

preferences.name: defaultKeyTerms
preferences.title: Default key terms
preferences.description: Comma-separated names/terms pre-filled into every transcription. Edit per-run in the form to override. AssemblyAI backend only — ignored by Local Parakeet.

preferences.name: transcriptionBackend
preferences.title: Transcription backend
preferences.description: AssemblyAI sends audio to the cloud. Local Parakeet runs on-device (Apple Silicon only).

preferences.name: parakeetBinaryPath
preferences.title: Parakeet binary path
preferences.description: Full path to the fluidaudiocli binary. Required when using Local Parakeet. See README for build instructions.

preferences.name: transcriptsFolder
preferences.title: Transcripts library folder
preferences.description: Folder where transcripts get saved. When set, every successful transcription auto-saves a JSON file here and the Transcriptions command lists them. Leave blank to save next to the source audio file (no library).

preferences.name: notifyOnComplete
preferences.title: Alert when background transcription completes
preferences.label: Show notification and auto-open Raycast
preferences.description: Off by default — background jobs complete silently and you check Review Transcriptions when you're ready. Turn on to get a macOS notification (via terminal-notifier if installed, else osascript) plus Raycast auto-opens to the result. See README for terminal-notifier install.

preferences.name: llmPolish
preferences.title: Polish Parakeet output with Claude
preferences.label: Add commas, em-dashes, and natural reading flow
preferences.description: After Parakeet transcribes, send the text through Claude Haiku to add punctuation around disfluencies (um, ah), em-dashes for self-corrections ("code coding" → "code—coding"), and fix sentence-boundary issues from mid-sentence diarization splits. Costs roughly $0.001 per transcript. Requires an Anthropic API key below. AssemblyAI already polishes — this only runs for Parakeet.

preferences.name: anthropicApiKey
preferences.title: Anthropic API key
preferences.description: Required for LLM Polish above. Get one at console.anthropic.com. Stored in macOS Keychain via Raycast.
